findings.body:
Parsed equality still permits changes outside the top-level version. New evidence beyond the earlier literal-string fixture is a multiline basic string containing a Unicode escape: `test = """
version = "v1.3.0"
"""
version = "v1.3.0"
`. Calling `set_version(text, "v1.3.0")` replaces the version-looking string inside `test` first. Both documents parse identically because the escape decodes to `3`, so this comparison succeeds and returns text with another setting's bytes changed. [TOML's string contract](https://toml.io/en/v1.0.0#string) permits these escapes in multiline basic strings. This violates item 3's byte-preservation guarantee on a same-release rerun; the new literal-string regression does not detect it. Locate the actual top-level assignment before editing and extend the preservation check to this case.
